context: 6 Conclusion We introduced Multistage Vertex Cover, proved it to be NP-hard even on restricted inputs, and studied its parameterized complexity regarding the natural parameters k, `, and τ (each given as input). We leave open whether MSVC parameterized by k is fixed-parameter tractable when each layer consists of only one edge (see Table 1). Moreover, it is open whether MSVC remains NP-hard on two layers each being a path (that is, strengthening Theorem 3.1(i)).
